results.name: container detection by magic bytes routes MP4/MOV and WebM/MKV; anything else is refused
MP4/MOV sweep (progressive, faststart, fragmented, MOV, video-only, audio-only) × exact + key-frame starts: FFmpeg decodes, frames hash-equal, packets byte-identical
WebM/MKV sweep (VP8+Opus, VP9+Opus, H.264+AAC with B-frames in MKV, Opus-only): start snaps to the key frame, FFmpeg decodes, frames hash-equal, packets byte-identical
WebM output is self-indexed: Duration, Cues pointing at key-frame clusters, SeekHead positions; re-parse gives rebased block times
real Chromium MediaRecorder WebM (unknown-size Segment and Clusters, no Cues, no Duration) is trimmed losslessly and plays back in Chromium
modal-shortcut failure: cutting WebM at the requested frame without its key frame is caught by the oracle (frames differ or fail to decode)
negative shapes (≥15): ranges, truncation, damaged sizes, DRM, multi-edit lists, several sample descriptions, bogus sample counts, EBML damage — clear refusals, never garbage
unusual-but-valid shapes: size-0 (to EOF) mdat, 64-bit largesize mdat, co64 chunk offsets, truncated live WebM recording — all trim and verify
int16 cluster-relative timestamps: a 100 s audio-only Matroska with 40 s source clusters splits so every relative time fits
irregular recorder timestamps: the reported end never passes the next real frame (synthetic gaps 40/10 ms)
Media module wiring: Lossless cut button + exact-start toggle exist, the re-encode path stays, and the old 'not bundled' blocker text is gone
